source_files.role: Exact AUC column indexing, day/trial padding, log2 reward lags, stage masks and robustfit input ordering
Figure 3k complete nine-rat ordered population, PstructCPIn input, seven prior rewards, 0 to 0.5 second endpoints, Proestrus/Diestrus ordering

source_acquisition: Reused preexisting external pinned source cache; both content hashes rechecked. No new remote requests or acquired bytes.

preserved_scientific_scope.coefficient_estimator: Native MATLAB robustfit; not implemented or substituted
preserved_scientific_scope.companion_controls: Existing Figure 2 stage/serum component remains separate; other Figure 3 RPE and supplied BestFits analyses remain unimplemented

prospective_export_validity_checks: Require original behavior order to equal source constructed sorted day/trial order; reject duplicate identities instead of silent positional relabeling.
Reject nonpositive or missing current rewards instead of creating nonfinite/complex log2 values or silently deleting rows before the original stage mask.
Require finite signal or explicit null, rectangular CPIn and a clock resolving both AUC endpoints.
Require all nine source rats; never select a reduced cohort to pass checks.
Require at least seven padded trial positions per rat; shorter support fails the source MATLAB lag assignment.
preserved_source_discrepancies: Unshifted pstruct column indices and rectangular sum*dt differ from Figure 2's stripped, baseline-subtracted trapezoid calculation.
Lagging follows day concatenation and may cross sessions.
Executable stage-only mask differs from mixed-block/nonviolation comments.
